description: This file contains implementation of Curve25519 cryptographic operations, including key generation, scalar multiplication, and signature verification, with references to external cryptographic libraries and Fiat-generated field arithmetic functions.

methods.name: load_3
methods.description: Loads 3 bytes into a 64-bit integer with little-endian order.

methods.name: load_4
methods.description: Loads 4 bytes into a 64-bit integer with little-endian order.

methods.name: fe_frombytes_strict
methods.description: Converts a 32-byte array into a field element, asserting top bit is clear.

methods.name: fe_frombytes
methods.description: Converts a 32-byte array into a field element, masking the top bit.

methods.name: fe_tobytes
methods.description: Serializes a field element into 32-byte array.

methods.name: fe_0
methods.description: Sets a field element to zero.

methods.name: fe_1
methods.description: Sets a field element to one.

methods.name: fe_add
methods.description: Adds two field elements.

methods.name: fe_sub
methods.description: Subtracts two field elements.

methods.name: fe_carry
methods.description: Reduces a loose field element to a proper field element.

methods.name: fe_mul_impl
methods.description: Performs field multiplication of two limb arrays.

methods.name: fe_mul_ttt
methods.description: Multiplies two field elements.

methods.name: fe_sq_tl
methods.description: Squares a field element.

methods.name: fe_invert
methods.description: Computes multiplicative inverse of a field element.

methods.name: x25519_ge_frombytes_vartime
methods.description: Decodes a public key into a group element, variable time.

methods.name: x25519_ge_scalarmult_base
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of the base point.

methods.name: x25519_ge_tobytes
methods.description: Serializes a group element to bytes.

methods.name: X25519_keypair
methods.description: Generates a keypair with a random private key.

methods.name: X25519_public_from_private
methods.description: Computes public key from private key.

methods.name: X25519
methods.description: Computes shared secret from private and peer public keys.
